checks.explanation: No D-selection disclosure text appears in the disclosures array, so placement cannot be evaluated.
No basic services fee line item with includesText is present in the items to evaluate for adequacy.
No second mandatory fee for facilities, staff or overhead such as a basic facilities fee appears; receiving charge is a single required-item price.
No D-embalming disclosure appears in the disclosures array, so placement cannot be evaluated.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral.
The D-alt-container disclosure is on page 1, the same page as the direct cremation range, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation is offered but no text says a casket is required for it; options use alternative containers.
Direct cremation descriptions do not detail the crematory fee and no cash-advance listing is shown, so no inconsistency appears.
Receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial have their own lines but forwarding remains from another funeral home has no line in the list.
No optional package at one price is shown; direct cremation and immediate burial ranges are required items, not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires purchase of any item.
No text claims long-term preservation or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosure and the present disclosure appears in standard wording.
